settings_help.source: (bool) - Keep the run's working masks/ folders after every field is merged. Off by default: they are removed once each field is committed to fov.ome.zarr (or merged/ for 'npy' and timelapse runs), which holds the channels and every mask. With fov.ome.zarr every segmentation stage writes its masks straight into the field's labels and no masks/ folder is created (the normalised batches are built in memory; the run's small records go to fov.ome.zarr/.spacr_mask_run); kept, those labels are reused by a rerun, otherwise a rerun segments again. With fov.ome.zarr no stack/ folder is written at all: preprocessing stores each field's channels straight into fov.ome.zarr. Older projects' stack/ folders are still read, and kept or removed by this setting as before.
